== Summary ==
Identified: none. Friday-night team tournament, table 34. Left: glasses, a beard, and a grey hoodie over a green shirt. Mid-left: glasses, dark hair, and a grey hoodie, gesturing. Mid-right: a tan cap, a beard, and a green tee, looking down. Right: a black SWCCG Players Committee cap and a blue NASA-logo tee, facing the camera (this cap and shirt recur in other 2023 stills). Faces unlabeled.
The Friday-night team tournament, table 34.
